_comment: Repository cards are maintained manually for GitHub Pages. Future enhancement: fetch public repositories from the GitHub API at build time.
name: VeSpA
description: Open-source pipeline for vessel segmentation, morphometric quantification, spatial vessel metrics, and vascular analysis in histological images.

name: IMC-Data-Analysis
description: Imaging Mass Cytometry analysis workflows for segmentation, cell phenotyping, spatial biology, and downstream analysis using R and Python.

name: imc-nextflow-pipeline
description: Reproducible Nextflow pipeline for IMC data processing, channel stacking, panel generation, Steinbock segmentation, and feature extraction.

name: qupath-vessel-segmentation-plugin
description: QuPath plugin for vessel segmentation and annotation generation from images loaded directly in QuPath.

name: complete-imc-analysis-workflow
description: Complete end-to-end Imaging Mass Cytometry workflow for reproducible analysis, phenotyping, and spatial interpretation.

name: hpc-slurm-job-generator
description: Python GUI for generating self-contained Slurm scripts to run IMC Steinbock segmentation pipelines on HPC resources.
